baseline_roles: never, always and unscoped reopening policies
pure information gain and deterministic acquisition proxy
OpenML generic information-gain refinement and boosted proxy
Defects4J deterministic name-matching and information-gain comparators
oracle bounds used only for interpretation
comparisons.minimum_mechanism: The minimum mechanism is a finite partition of worlds plus one optimal action per fibre. The manuscript uses that object directly and does not attribute the result to a larger state architecture.

decision.reason: Six controlled mechanism families, a corrected finite criterion, and three bounded real-data studies form a coherent specialist paper whose adverse transfer and CANNOT_CHECK results materially limit the interpretation.

external_validity.description: The strongest external evidence is retrospective use of public OpenML, Defects4J and WorkflowHub records with held-out splits. The paper claims bounded transfer behavior, not deployment, prospective agent performance or population prevalence.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Use one finite binding criterion to connect the six families and let real-data failures change the conclusion rather than presenting a catalogue of wins.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Six heterogeneous synthetic studies could read as portfolio fragmentation rather than one scientific question.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Report the family or dataset/project as the scientific unit, preserve unadjusted multiplicity, and prohibit cross-family prevalence or pooled transfer inference.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Thousands of episodes, rows and tests could be used as pseudo-replication, while twelve synthetic comparisons lack corrected mean-bootstrap intervals.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Withdraw the impure-split shorthand, prove the joint refined-subfibre optimum criterion, and exhaustively check both the corrected equivalence and a counterexample to the old wording.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: The generic theorem is established decision theory, and the earlier strictness statement was mathematically underspecified.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Classify same-distribution agreement as an identity check and place scientific weight only on held-out transfer, including all adverse and cannot-assess outcomes.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Calling empirical-distribution agreement a real-domain theorem confirmation would turn an algebraic identity into external validation.

hostile_panel.closure_test: Credit stale-memory, provenance, verification, value-of-information and Blackwell-style lineages; define the residual as matched-information mechanism isolation plus transfer boundaries.
hostile_panel.fatal_objection: Every component mechanism and the finite decision identity has strong prior ownership, so a feature-union novelty claim would fail.

scientific_validity_evidence: matched visible information within each synthetic family
retained negative, corrected and CANNOT_CHECK outcomes

next_discriminator.closure_test: A prospectively frozen, independently governed multi-domain study estimates fibre actions without outcome leakage and shows stable held-out value against strong matched-information comparators, with failures and no-value strata retained.
next_discriminator.task: Run a larger prospective transfer study with independently governed state labels, several domains and enough independent datasets or deployments to model transfer failure.
next_discriminator.why_it_changes_decision: It could support a broader practical or top-tier claim, but is not required for the present controlled-mechanism and bounded-transfer paper.

novelty.component_novelty: No novelty is claimed for typed memory, provenance, stale-state revision, matched-budget verification, value-of-information, active learning, decision sufficiency, Blackwell comparison or refinement monotonicity.
novelty.composition_novelty: One matched-information protocol applies explicit epistemic bindings across six frozen mechanisms and pairs them with a corrected finite decision criterion and three transparent real-data boundary studies.
novelty.emergent_result: Same-distribution decision value can be exact while held-out value is adverse, mixed or unassessable; the paper separates mechanism identification from transfer instead of using exactness as a proxy for practical benefit.

adverse_or_null_results: Both scoped-versus-never reopening intervals contain zero.
The no-remint transport regime is an exact tie.
Two policy candidates are absorbed by stronger same-information donors.
The earlier theorem shorthand is withdrawn and has an explicit counterexample.
OpenML held-out transfer is adverse on three of five datasets relative to the oracle-achievable gap.
One Defects4J project has a genuine unexplained held-out failure; a proposed aggregate shortcut fails on the only no-value project.
WorkflowHub is CANNOT_CHECK_NO_CONTRAST for the two-sided criterion.
scientific_mass.dependence_notes: The six synthetic families are distinct mechanisms but share one design programme and are not independent populations. OpenML datasets, Defects4J projects and the WorkflowHub corpus are not pooled. Episodes, rows, bugs, candidate tests, chains and bootstrap resamples are never counted as independent cross-domain evidence.
scientific_mass.failure_opportunities: Every synthetic family contains a hostile or no-value regime; the corrected theorem checker includes a counterexample to the withdrawn wording; real-data studies include held-out evaluation, a no-value project, an unexplained failure, amendments and a missing-contrast CANNOT_CHECK.
scientific_mass.independent_unit_type: separately frozen mechanism family or real-data dataset, project or corpus object

sibling_overlap.merge_test: ORION-08 uniquely studies whether explicit epistemic bindings change decisions under matched information and why same-distribution value may fail to transfer. Adaptive compute allocation and responsibility-carrying state ask different intervention and validity questions.

surviving_claim.plain_language: Six exact-synthetic matched-information families isolate how typed epistemic bindings can change decisions; a corrected finite criterion identifies when refinement lowers risk on a fixed distribution, while three real-data studies show that held-out transfer is mixed and cannot be inferred from same-distribution identities.
surviving_claim.posterior_change: Typed detail has decision value only when refined subfibres require incompatible optimal actions on the distribution being optimized, and even exact same-distribution value does not establish held-out usefulness.
